name: portfolio-workspace
description: 3D room (portfolio-3d) > macOS desktop (macos-portfolio) > Dev Quest game (pixel-quest-portfolio). Deploy portfolio-3d/dist.

scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix pixel-quest-portfolio && npm ci --prefix macos-portfolio && npm ci --prefix portfolio-3d
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix macos-portfolio && npm run lint --prefix portfolio-3d && npm run typecheck --prefix pixel-quest-portfolio
scripts.test: npm test --prefix pixel-quest-portfolio && npm test --prefix macos-portfolio
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && npm run smoke && npm run e2e
scripts.check:launch: npm run validate && npm run check
